title: Ever platform catalog
description: The catalog the App Launcher reads at runtime (APW-11 FR-8…FR-14). Mirrors the zod rules of APW-11 plan §5.2 one for one; `.github/workflows/validate.yml` enforces the two rules JSON Schema cannot express on its own — unique ids and the icon byte cap.

$comment.description: Free-form note for humans. Ignored by every reader.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only for a breaking change to this file's shape.

catalogVersion.description: Surfaced to the client verbatim (AppLauncherListResponse.meta.catalogVersion) and tagged in the repository.

platforms.description: At most 24 entries: APW-11 FR-11 drops anything past the 24th, so CI refuses the 25th instead of letting it disappear silently.

id.description: Stable id. Becomes the item key `platform:<id>` and the preference row's itemKey, so it is never renamed — a rename loses every pin on that platform.

icon.description: Path inside this repository. The reader inlines the bytes as a data URI (≤ 16 KB), and an SVG is rejected when it contains `<script`, `on…=`, `javascript:` or `<foreignObject` (APW-11 FR-14).

order.description: Sort key; ties break by name (APW-11 FR-11).

urls.description: One address per environment. All three keys are supported and each is optional: an entry without an address for the environment the installation is running in is simply not shown (APW-11 FR-10, ACC-11-05).

httpsUrl.description: https only — `http:`, `javascript:`, `data:` and every other scheme are refused at validation time and again at render time (APW-11 FR-32, S16).
